label: Preseason Week 2
method: Saturday rollup of nightly search_news + counts; items already filter-passed; no invented nights
headline: Preseason Week 2 was camp, joints, and Saturday exhibitions. Cleveland and Buffalo owned the volume: Shedeur versus Watson all week, then a 31-7 Bills win. The rooms that stuck for status were Seattle (Jake Bobo to IR), Detroit (LaPorta hip), Philadelphia (Jackson carted, Wilson waived), and San Francisco (Herbert in, Taylor to IR, Kittle still pointed at Week 1). Mahomes is still on track for the opener. Quiet is still quiet. Vibe only.

items.title: Cardinals Activate Garrett Williams from PUP List Before Preseason Finale
items.one_line: Eight months after tearing his Achilles, Garrett Williams stepped back onto the practice field with a smile, ready to bolster Arizona's secondary.

items.title: Cowboys and Cardinals Square Off in Preseason Nightcap at State Farm Stadium
items.one_line: Dallas (1-0 preseason) faces Arizona (1-1) tonight at 10 p.m. ET on NFL Network, with most starters resting to spotlight the QB battle between Sam Howell and Joe Milton III plus rookies like linebacker Jaishawn Barham.

items.title: Colts-Falcons Joint Practices Spark Social Media Highlights
items.one_line: The Indianapolis Colts and Atlanta Falcons wrapped joint practices August 19-20 at Grand Park in Westfield, Indiana, delivering intense reps ahead of preseason.

items.title: Falcons Agree to Sell 10% Stake to Arctos at $10.6 Billion Valuation
items.one_line: Private equity firm Arctos has agreed to purchase a 10% minority stake in the Atlanta Falcons, valuing the NFL team at $10.6 billion, with the deal unfolding in two parts over 18 months.

items.title: Rookie QB Jack Strand Powers Falcons' 34-6 Preseason Rout of Colts
items.one_line: Undrafted Jack Strand went 12 of 17 for 212 yards, a TD pass to Cash Jones, and a 16-yard rushing score as Atlanta piled up 461 yards; Cooper Rush started 10 of 11 for 86 yards.

items.title: J.J. McCarthy's Mixed Preseason Debut Steals Vikings-Ravens Spotlight
items.one_line: Baltimore beat Minnesota 13-3 at U.S. Bank Stadium; McCarthy started 5-of-10 for 81 yards with a 50-yard strike to Tai Felton before red-zone misses, as Lamar Jackson sat after joint practices.

items.title: Texans Explore Trade for Ravens Receiver Rashod Bateman
items.one_line: League sources say Houston inquired about Bateman after placing Jayden Higgins on season-ending IR; Bateman is signed through 2029, and the Ravens notified the NFL about a June family-violence case still under league review.

items.title: Ravens' Trenton Simpson Wows Fans with Explosive Practice Clips
items.one_line: The 25-year-old linebacker posted training camp footage highlighting his speed, power, and 6-foot-2, 242-pound frame; fans predicted he'll be Baltimore's LB1 for years alongside Roquan Smith.

items.title: Dion Dawkins Dominates Jared Verse in Bills-Browns Joint Practice
items.one_line: Dion Dawkins stonewalled Jared Verse's rushes all day, trading trash talk in a heated one-on-one drill that had both players grinning post-practice.

items.title: Josh Allen Tops Multiple ESPN QB Rankings for 2026 Season
items.one_line: ESPN lists and a poll of executives, coaches, and scouts rank Buffalo's Josh Allen as the top quarterback heading into 2026, ahead of Lamar Jackson, Patrick Mahomes, and Joe Burrow.

items.title: Sanders Shines Early as Browns Lose to Bills in QB Battle
items.one_line: Buffalo beat Cleveland 31-7 at Huntington Bank Field; Shedeur Sanders went 9-of-11 for 74 yards with a TD and an interception before halftime, while Deshaun Watson was 5-of-12 for 35 yards with a pick amid home boos.

items.title: Panthers Rest Key Defensive Starters for Jaguars Preseason Game
items.one_line: Carolina will miss outside linebacker Jaelan Phillips, cornerback Jaycee Horn, inside linebacker Devin Lloyd, and defensive tackle Derrick Brown in Friday's preseason matchup against Jacksonville.

items.title: Panthers Rookie Jonathon Brooks Scores First NFL Touchdown
items.one_line: In Friday night's preseason game against the Jaguars, Carolina Panthers rookie Jonathon Brooks ran in a 1-yard touchdown early in the first quarter after two prior ACL tears sidelined him most of last season.

items.title: Fans Clash Over Bryce Young vs. Trey Lance Starting QB Debate
items.one_line: A post listed Tua Tagovailoa, Deshaun Watson, Jacoby Brissett, and Bryce Young as current starters ahead of Lance, prompting Panthers supporters to highlight Young's 2025 career highs under coach Dave Canales.

items.title: Packers-Bears Rivalry Heats Up with Coach Shots and Fan Clashes
items.one_line: After the Bears beat the Packers twice last season, including in the playoffs, coach Ben Johnson stirred things by targeting Packers coach Matt LaFleur.

items.title: Jaylon Johnson Shuts Down Ja'Marr Chase in Bears-Bengals Practice
items.one_line: Chicago Bears cornerback Jaylon Johnson dominated star receiver Ja'Marr Chase in team drills at the Bengals' Kettering Health Practice Fields, breaking up a key red-zone pass that linebacker Devin Bush intercepted.

items.title: Caleb Williams Suited Up for Bears-Bengals Preseason Game
items.one_line: Caleb Williams dressed for tonight's preseason matchup at Paycor Stadium; Ben Johnson said he will play as needed to run a full night-game routine after this week's joint practice, while Zac Taylor rests most Bengals starters.

items.title: Joe Burrow Demands Bengals Super Bowl Push Now
items.one_line: After a joint practice with the Chicago Bears at Paycor Stadium on August 20, Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow told reporters he's done with 'next year' talk and ready to manifest a Super Bowl run this season.

items.title: Joe Burrow Sets High Stakes for Bengals' 2026 Rebound
items.one_line: After a 6-11 finish, Burrow told ESPN he sees 2026 as make-or-break, pointing to extensions for himself, Tee Higgins, and Ja'Marr Chase plus additions like Boye Mafe and Dexter Lawrence.

items.title: Bengals Rookie Colbie Young Scores First NFL Touchdown in Preseason Win Push
items.one_line: Fourth-round pick Colbie Young from Georgia caught a 17-yard TD from Josh Johnson late in the second quarter Saturday, boosting his roster hopes alongside Dohnte Meyers.

items.title: Sanders Shines Early as Browns Lose to Bills in QB Battle
items.one_line: Cleveland lost 31-7; Shedeur Sanders went 9-of-11 for 74 yards, one TD, and one interception before halftime, while Deshaun Watson was 5-of-12 for 35 yards with a pick as coach Todd Monken weighs the starter.

items.title: Browns Sign Rookie TE Drew Biber, IR Jack Stoll
items.one_line: The Cleveland Browns added some fresh legs to their tight end room with rookie Drew Biber, while sidelining Jack Stoll due to injury.

items.title: Browns QBs Split Reps, Concepcion Shines in Joint Practice with Bills
items.one_line: Shedeur Sanders and Deshaun Watson alternated first-team reps; KC Concepcion stood out, and defensive end Alex Wright suffered a lower-leg injury and was carted off.

items.title: NFL Fines Cowboys and Saints $500,000 Each for Joint Practice Fights
items.one_line: Fists flew and a German suplex stunned onlookers during a heated joint practice in Oxnard, prompting coaches to consider calling it early.

items.title: Cowboys and Cardinals Square Off in Preseason Nightcap at State Farm Stadium
items.one_line: Dallas (1-0) faces Arizona tonight at 10 p.m. ET on NFL Network, with most starters resting so Brian Schottenheimer can evaluate the Sam Howell–Joe Milton III QB battle and rookies like Jaishawn Barham.

items.title: Cowboys Wrap Up 2026 Training Camp in Oxnard
items.one_line: The Dallas Cowboys finished their California training camp in Oxnard before heading to Arizona for a preseason game against the Cardinals and more practices in Frisco.

items.title: Broncos Sign Veteran Safety Taylor Rapp to Bolster Secondary
items.one_line: The Broncos added 28-year-old Taylor Rapp, a former second-round pick with 72 NFL starts, as depth behind Talanoa Hufanga and Brandon Jones after P.J. Locke departed for Dallas.

items.title: Bo Nix Shines in Preseason Return from Broken Ankle
items.one_line: Nix completed 6 of 9 for 76 yards and a touchdown Friday vs. Green Bay, including a 35-yarder to Jaylen Waddle and a 21-yard score to RJ Harvey, in his first game since a January ankle fracture.

items.title: Bo Nix Debuts as Broncos Host Packers in Home Preseason Opener
items.one_line: The Denver Broncos welcomed the Green Bay Packers to Mile High for their home preseason opener; Bo Nix took about 14 snaps in his debut while coach Sean Payton focused on roster evaluation.

items.title: Lions Host Hernandez and Tomlinson Workouts for Guard Depth
items.one_line: The Lions worked out Will Hernandez and Laken Tomlinson to bolster depth amid injuries, including Ben Bartch's concussion protocol; reports indicate the team is signing Hernandez to a one-year deal.

items.title: Lions' Sam LaPorta Sits Out Practice with Hip Injury Ahead of Opener
items.one_line: Tight end Sam LaPorta is sidelined with a hip flare-up from a practice hit; coach Dan Campbell remains optimistic long-term but won't commit to Week 1 readiness.

items.title: Lions Edge Commanders 17-13 in Preseason Thriller with Daniels Debut
items.one_line: Detroit beat Washington 17-13 on Saturday behind rushing scores including Josh Dobbs; Jayden Daniels played three snaps (0-for-1, a sack) in his preseason debut with Terry McLaurin and Stefon Diggs.

items.title: Fans Slam Broncos and Packers Backup QBs After Preseason Loss
items.one_line: Jarrett Stidham went 9 of 15 for 82 yards with an interception (47.1 rating) for Denver, and Packers fans also piled on veteran backup Tyrod Taylor after Friday's exhibition.

items.title: Packers Rookie Cisse Limps Off but Shows Quick Recovery Signs
items.one_line: Second-round corner Brandon Cisse left Friday's game vs. Denver after a kickoff-return tweak, then returned to the sideline for drills and a stationary bike with Matt LaFleur checking in.

items.title: Packers-Bears Rivalry Heats Up with Coach Shots and Fan Clashes
items.one_line: After the Bears beat the Packers twice last season, including in the playoffs, Bears coach Ben Johnson stirred things by targeting Packers coach Matt LaFleur.

items.title: Colts Kicking Battle Tilts Toward Shrader After Strong Preseason Game
items.one_line: In Saturday's 34-6 loss, Spencer Shrader went 2-for-2 from 48 and 53 yards while Blake Grupe missed a 36-yarder; Shane Steichen called it a big decision as Shrader sits 4-of-4 in preseason games.

items.title: Rookie QB Jack Strand Powers Falcons' 34-6 Preseason Rout of Colts
items.one_line: Atlanta dominated at Lucas Oil Stadium as Jack Strand threw for 212 yards and two total TDs; Indianapolis was on the wrong end of 461 Falcons yards.

items.title: DeForest Buckner Dominates Falcons Linemen in Joint Practice
items.one_line: DeForest Buckner turned heads by powering through Atlanta Falcons linemen like they were standing still. One clip showed him sending All-Pro guard Chris Lindstrom on skates with a brutal bull rush.

items.title: Panthers Rest Key Defensive Starters for Jaguars Preseason Game
items.one_line: Carolina will miss Jaelan Phillips, Jaycee Horn, Devin Lloyd, and Derrick Brown in Friday's preseason matchup against Jacksonville after minor issues in Wednesday's practice.

items.title: Jaguars' Parker Washington Set to Return to Practice Next Week
items.one_line: The 24-year-old Jacksonville Jaguars slot receiver missed Tuesday's session but is expected to resume practice next week, with no long-term concerns.

items.title: Panthers Rookie Jonathon Brooks Scores First NFL Touchdown
items.one_line: In Friday night's preseason game against the Jaguars, Carolina Panthers rookie Jonathon Brooks ran in a 1-yard touchdown early in the first quarter.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes on Track for Week 1 Return After Knee Surgery
items.one_line: ESPN's Adam Schefter reports the Chiefs quarterback is set to play Week 1 after tearing his ACL and LCL last December, following successful surgery in Dallas.

items.title: Kenneth Walker III Poised for Big Role in Chiefs Backfield
items.one_line: After signing with Kansas City in free agency, Walker has emerged as the primary red-zone back and screen-game target in training camp, with reports noting the Chiefs getting him the ball constantly.

items.title: Chiefs Rookie R Mason Thomas Impresses in Preseason Debut
items.one_line: The second-round edge from Oklahoma deflected a key third-down pass and showed explosive get-off against Tampa Bay, drawing praise from columnist Sam McDowell for a different look under Spags.

items.title: Raiders Propose $158 Million Upgrade to Allegiant Stadium's North Entrance
items.one_line: Imagine stepping onto a glowing elevated plaza that turns the stadium's north side into a true front door for fans. The Raiders want to make that vision real with better access and event space.

items.title: Raiders Rookie QB Fernando Mendoza Divides Fans with Upbeat Interviews
items.one_line: After grueling practices, 22-year-old Fernando Mendoza flashes a big smile and says, 'This is what I love.' His polished enthusiasm has fans buzzing in two directions.

items.title: Raiders Coach Kubiak Holds Off on Naming Starting QB After Preseason Win
items.one_line: In a 22-20 win over the Texans, rookie Fernando Mendoza started but threw a pick-six early; Aidan O'Connell sparked a second-half comeback, and Kubiak kept the competition open.

items.title: Cole Strange Struggles Spark Chargers Line Concerns in Preseason Loss
items.one_line: In a 41-17 preseason defeat to the San Francisco 49ers, new right guard Cole Strange struggled in clips that spread fast, prompting worries about the interior line.

items.title: Debate Heats Up Over Trey Lance's NFL Future
items.one_line: Drafted third overall by the 49ers in 2021, Lance now backs up Justin Herbert with the Chargers on a one-year deal and made the 2026 roster after showing college-level speed in recent action.

items.title: Chargers Tackle Rashawn Slater Returns to Practice in Limited Role
items.one_line: Jim Harbaugh confirmed Slater practiced limited Saturday after a patellar tendon tear that cost him 2025 and a recent knee flare-up; Tarheeb Still and Tre' Harris were also limited, Quentin Johnston and Brenen Thompson sat.

items.title: Stafford and Adams Shine in Rams-Saints Joint Practice
items.one_line: The Los Angeles Rams and New Orleans Saints held a joint practice Thursday in Woodland Hills, where Stafford connected sharply with Adams on crossers, slants, and fades.

items.title: Giants Dominate Dolphins in Intense Joint Practice
items.one_line: On August 20 in South Florida, Jaxson Dart went 16-of-22 with a 50-yard bomb and the Giants defense logged over six sacks, with fights breaking out amid the physicality.

items.title: Dolphins Claim Rookie CB Jai’Onte’ McMillan Off Waivers from Colts
items.one_line: Miami claimed the undrafted TCU/Minnesota corner mid-game Saturday, releasing Nick McCloud to add secondary depth before cutdown day.

items.title: Odell Beckham Jr. Flashes Vintage Skills in Giants Preseason Rout
items.one_line: New York beat Miami 26-3 at Hard Rock Stadium; OBJ delivered jukes and a first-down catch after rejoining the Giants, as both clubs evaluated depth after 0-1 starts.

items.title: Jets Eyeing Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy Amid Geno Smith Camp Struggles
items.one_line: Speculation is swirling that the New York Jets could pursue a trade for Vikings quarterback J.J. McCarthy if Geno Smith's shaky camp persists; Minnesota named Kyler Murray their Week 1 starter.

items.title: Patriots Host Eagles in Second Preseason Clash at Gillette
items.one_line: New England welcomed Philadelphia to Foxborough on Saturday night, resting most starters after joint practices to evaluate depth in the final home preseason game.

items.title: Drake Maye Lands at No. 11 on NFL Top 100 Players of 2026
items.one_line: The player-voted list put Maye 11th after a 2025 season of 72% completions, 4,394 yards, 31 TDs, and eight picks, ahead of Patrick Mahomes at No. 18.

items.title: Saints and Rams Kick Off Joint Practice in California
items.one_line: Under clear blue skies in Woodland Hills, Saints and Rams players stretched on lush green turf, gearing up for intense matchups ahead of their preseason clash.

items.title: Saints Fans Split on Resting Starter Shough in Preseason
items.one_line: Kellen Moore has kept Tyler Shough and over 30 projected starters out of preseason games, using joint practices vs. Dallas and the Rams instead; critics note his limited experience and Alvin Kamara's injury.

items.title: Odell Beckham Jr. Flashes Vintage Skills in Giants Preseason Rout
items.one_line: OBJ shook defenders and snagged a first-down catch in New York's 26-3 preseason win over Miami at Hard Rock Stadium after rejoining the club earlier this year.

items.title: Giants Rest Dart, Tracy Fumbles in Dolphins Preseason Clash
items.one_line: Jaxson Dart sat while some starters played; Tyrone Tracy Jr. fumbled in the red zone on a wet ball amid backfield competition from Najee Harris as coaches evaluate final cuts.

items.title: Giants Fans and Ravens Rivals Trade Banter Over Harbaugh's Hiring
items.one_line: Giants fans are buzzing with wide-eyed memes of a reclining supporter clutching a framed jersey, while Ravens faithful fire back with reminders of New York's long dry spell.

items.title: Geno Smith Leads Jets on Perfect Opening Drive vs. Steelers
items.one_line: In the 2026 preseason game, Smith completed 7-for-7 for 65 yards with a touchdown on the opening drive, converting two third downs against Pittsburgh's starters minus T.J. Watt.

items.title: Garrett Wilson's Route-Running Precision Shines in Jets' Preseason Shutout
items.one_line: Wilson's third-and-6 grab from Geno Smith, who went 7-for-7 on a 10-play TD drive, highlighted New York's 17-0 preseason win over Pittsburgh.

items.title: Jets Rookie Cade Klubnik Shines in Practice with Perfect Red-Zone Passes
items.one_line: Cade Klubnik stepped into the huddle with the first-team offense and didn't miss a beat, hitting all five passes including two touchdowns to Garrett Wilson and Jelani Woods.

items.title: Eagles Rookie Jackson Hurt on Opening Kickoff vs. Patriots
items.one_line: Running back Ja’Quinden Jackson went down tackling on the opening kickoff Saturday at Gillette, showed movement in all extremities, and was taken to a hospital for checks.

items.title: Patriots Host Eagles in Second Preseason Clash at Gillette
items.one_line: Philadelphia visited Foxborough in white road jerseys Saturday night, resting most starters after joint practices to evaluate depth.

items.title: Eagles Waive Injured Rookie WR Johnny Wilson, Add Lineman and Receiver
items.one_line: The Philadelphia Eagles waived wide receiver Johnny Wilson with an injury designation after knee issues, signed center Zeke Correll and wide receiver Brandon Hayes, and placed cornerback Tariq Castro-Fields on injured reserve.

items.title: Steelers Eye Four Quarterbacks on Roster for First Time in Decades
items.one_line: Pittsburgh appears set to carry Aaron Rodgers as starter, Mason Rudolph as backup, and both young passers Will Howard and Drew Allar on the 53-man roster, last done in 1995.

items.title: NFL Teams Eye Steelers' Joey Porter Jr. as Trade Target
items.one_line: Joey Porter Jr. is drawing interest from teams like the Packers; Steelers sources deny any trade inquiries, and a back injury has sidelined him since training camp.

items.title: Geno Smith Leads Jets on Perfect Opening Drive vs. Steelers
items.one_line: Smith went 7-for-7 with a touchdown on the opening drive against Pittsburgh's starters minus T.J. Watt in Friday's preseason game.

items.title: Seahawks' Jake Bobo Suffers Serious Knee Injury in Titans Practice
items.one_line: During Friday's joint practice in Nashville, Seahawks wide receiver Jake Bobo went down with a serious knee injury that coach Mike Macdonald called potentially long-term.

items.title: Seahawks Sale to Khosla Family Nears NFL Approval at Record $9.6 Billion
items.one_line: The Paul G. Allen estate is passing the Seahawks torch to the Khosla family after guiding the team to a Super Bowl win just this year. Fans cherish the stability that kept the franchise rooted in Seattle.

items.title: Seahawks Sign Pro Bowl Corner Trevon Diggs to One-Year Deal
items.one_line: Trevon Diggs, the 27-year-old interception machine with 20 career picks, just joined the Super Bowl champion Seahawks to shore up their injury-hit secondary.

items.title: 49ers Sign RB Khalil Herbert, Place Taylor on IR Before Chargers Game
items.one_line: Herbert rejoins the team on a one-year deal after an earlier August release; Patrick Taylor Jr. goes to IR amid injuries to Jordan James and Isaac Guerendo.

items.title: George Kittle's Achilles Recovery Ahead of Schedule for 49ers Opener
items.one_line: The three-time Pro Bowl tight end received an encouraging report from Dr. Neal ElAttrache that puts him on track for the September 10 regular-season opener against the Rams in Melbourne, Australia.

items.title: 49ers' Pleasants Injured in Preseason Win Over Chargers
items.one_line: The 49ers beat the Chargers 41-17, but offensive lineman Austen Pleasants left with a knee injury; coach Kyle Shanahan said imaging is coming but it's not believed to be an ACL tear.

items.title: Buccaneers Lock in Vita Vea with $30M One-Year Extension
items.one_line: After a tense hold-in and trade request, Vita Vea grinned in uniform as the Buccaneers announced the deal that keeps their defensive anchor home.

items.title: Buccaneers Rookie Rueben Bain Jr. Impresses in NFL Debut
items.one_line: The 15th overall pick from Miami generated third-down pressure with his hump move in Saturday's preseason game against Kansas City.

items.title: Titans QB Cam Ward Faces Early Preseason Scrutiny
items.one_line: Ward went 5-for-12 for 57 yards in the Titans' Aug. 13 win over the 49ers; ESPN's Dan Orlovsky urged better play starting in Week 2 of the preseason against the Seahawks.

items.title: Seahawks' Jake Bobo Suffers Serious Knee Injury in Titans Practice
items.one_line: Bobo went down on his right leg Friday during a joint practice in Nashville; both clubs paused for prayer, and Mike Macdonald called it a serious knee issue.

items.title: Dan Quinn Says Commanders Must Figure Out Center After Preseason Loss
items.one_line: After a 17-13 loss to Detroit, Quinn praised Brandon Coleman (in for injured Laremy Tunsil) and Sam Cosmi but said center is unresolved among Nick Allegretti, rookie Matt Gulbin, and Julian Good-Jones.

items.title: Commanders Fans Say Rookie Kaliakmanis Secures QB3 Spot After Strong Preseason Outing
items.one_line: Seventh-rounder Athan Kaliakmanis went 11-for-14 for 162 yards with no turnovers in the Lions game and is 17-for-24 for 249 yards over two exhibitions, ahead of Sam Hartman.

items.title: Commanders' Wide Receiver Roster Battle Heats Up in Camp
items.one_line: The Washington Commanders' crowded wide receiver room has locks like Terry McLaurin, Stefon Diggs, and rookie Antonio Williams, plus a key clash between Treylon Burks and Dyami Brown.

note: First live rollup. Nights before Aug 20 were not archived. League even. Not a betting signal.
